about: Questions about the handbook of Spoke & Chain (spoke-and-chain.md), for build-project-rag. Kind words: the question shares words with the part that answers it; meaning: it asks the same in other words; none: the handbook does not answer it. fact: the words of the handbook that answer it, which a chunk holds when it holds the answer; answer: a regular expression a right answer matches in lower case.
